title: YOUHAN ONE verification record
description: What was actually run, and what it returned. Stores command names, exit codes and test identifiers only. It must never store full command output: a log copied into a repository artefact will eventually copy a credential (SPEC-0002/SEC-006).

verificationId.description: Must match the file name without the .json suffix. SDD-V049.

sessionId.description: The execution session whose work this verifies, when there is one.

tests.description: Test identifiers with their outcome. Every identifier must appear in the specification's test plan; SDD-V054 rejects one that does not.

commands.description: Commands executed, by name and exit code. No captured stdout or stderr.

result.description: PASS only when every required test in scope ran and passed. A skipped test is not a pass.

environment.description: Where the run happened, in words. Never a hostname carrying a secret, never a connection string.
